note: What a server sends to end the match and say which side won. The header names no object: it carries zero.

bits.name: side100Won
bits.note: Set where side 100 won, clear where side 200 did.

bits.name: surrendered
bits.note: Set aside for a match ended by surrender. A client does not read it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

revisions.note: Arriving while the match still loads, it has a client record the win or loss against its player's side and leave at once. Otherwise the client records it, ends the match on its screen and sends ClientFinished, except while playing a replay.

bits.name: side100Won
bits.note: Set where side 100 won and clear where side 200 won. A client compares the winning side with its own to show victory or defeat. The one payload captured has it set, at the end of a match in which side 200's nexus was destroyed and side 100's was not, sent to a client that had joined side 100.
